search.order: current scope E descending, stable ID tie-break
search.zero: baseline marker, no positive data pillar
search.topk: 8 high-exposure original categories plus focused category; full list retained; no artificial OTHER

flow.implementation: native interactive SVG exposure allocation map
flow.bandwidth: one linear exposure-pair scale for both sets of ribbons
flow.right_column: up to five same-scope products plus explicit remainder exposure
flow.category_order: current scope E descending, stable ID tie-break
flow.focus_mode: selected category exposure subset; original scope denominator retained
flow.raw_text: text nodes only; no HTML interpretation

products.size: constant; selection outline is not a data mark
products.overlap: stack count + list; no silent jitter
products.selected_item: pinned into render budget if threshold eligible

compare.style: A tint plus A label / B base plus B label

preview_renderer.implementation: in-package native WebGL1 optional / Canvas face projection fallback
preview_renderer.tested_path: Canvas face projection via Playwright set_content
preview_renderer.production: Three.js WebGL2 plus 2D fallback after M0 compatibility lock

priority.implementation: Vue native SVG; same immutable scope and shared diagnosis
priority.x: E_item; auto log1p when positive range ratio >=20, or explicit linear
priority.reference: full original category minus current item, same snapshot/scope/split

shapes.open_circle: read only, inadequate sample or peer feedback
shapes.numbered_label: neighbour items, expandable; original coordinates unchanged

priority.unplaced: zero exposure, unknown category, invalid or missing peer reference; retained in DOM list
priority.review_order: candidate exposure descending; treemap shows all currently filtered loaded candidates

default_presentation.implementation: Vue native SVG exposure treemap with immediate metric-specific inspection guidance
default_presentation.position: deterministic layout only; no metric or causal meaning
default_presentation.labels: state, title, exact E where space permits; full preview, native picker and readings remain available
default_presentation.zero_exposure: no area; retained in picker and exact readings
default_presentation.metric_change: state and advice update, geometry unchanged for the same population
default_presentation.scope: visible exposure coverage disclosed; full scope and peer reference unchanged
default_presentation.distribution: original signed-gap SVG retained on demand; its coordinate/category-color contract above remains valid
default_presentation.advice: same selected feedback metric; save exact counts and frozen scope
default_presentation.small_rate_format: adaptive 1-3 decimals; positive below 0.001 percent shown as <0.001%; raw values unchanged

structure.categories: all positive-exposure original categories in scope
structure.concentration: cumulative exposure and feedback in the same exposure-descending order
structure.K80: minimum category count covering 80 percent of scope exposure
structure.zero_feedback_total: null share, no fabricated point or line
